block.guhs.doos_knabbels.lore: A guh always picks the box. Always. Right-click in the evening: tuck your guh in.
item.guhs.droomkussen.lore: In a dream: right-click to wake up. At home: just very soft.
gui.guhs.dromen.reis.geen_droom: Guh Dreamland does not exist in this world. Not even in your dreams.
gui.guhs.dromen.reis.spel_bezig: Finish your game first, then you can dream!
gui.guhs.dromen.reis.kussen: You got a Dream Pillow: right-click with it to wake up.
gui.guhs.dromen.kussen.thuis: So soft... but you're not dreaming. Tuck a guh in first and go to sleep.
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.met: You tuck %1$s in, with %2$s. Sleep tight, njeg! Now go to sleep in a bed close by: you'll dream of %3$s.
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.zonder: You tuck %1$s in. Sleep tight, njeg! Now go to sleep in a bed close by: you'll dream of %2$s. (Give something along for another dream!)
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.uit: %s is awake again. Playing a bit longer after all?
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.geen_bedtijd: It's not bedtime yet, vads! Come back in the evening.
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.bezet: A guh is already sleeping here. Shh!
gui.guhs.dromen.instoppen.geen_guh: No guh of yours nearby to tuck in.
gui.guhs.dromen.regels.niet_bouwen: You can't build or break anything in a dream. Only dream, njeg.
gui.guhs.dromen.regels.bubbel: Plop! A Blub bubble caught you.
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap0: Alarm Guh: RIIIING! Good morning, sleepyhead!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap1: Alarm Guh: Five more minutes? Nope. RING!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap2: Alarm Guh: I set myself to 'vahoeg early'. Ring ring!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap3: Alarm Guh: Wake up! The nibbles are getting cold!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.grap4: Alarm Guh: Sorry, I have to. It's in my job description. RING!
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.vraag: Ring? Do you really want to wake up already, vadsje? It's still so cosy here...
gui.guhs.dromen.wekkerguh.nog_even: Alarm Guh hits his own snooze button. Zzz...
gui.guhs.dromen.bed.vraag: %s yawns and looks at you sleepily. Will you dream together, or do you just want a good sleep?
gui.guhs.dromen.bed.weg: Your dream buddy is just too far away... njeg.
